source_instruction: i am searching for a wall mounted floating shelf for my living room. it should be 24 inch size and natural color.
query: I was just rearranging my kitchen shelves earlier and knocked over my favorite ceramic cereal bowl, chipping the rim so bad it leaks milk now. I spent 20 minutes sweeping up tiny shards off the linoleum before I remembered I was supposed to be shopping for furniture, and now I can’t stop thinking about how I need to pick up a replacement bowl on my way home tomorrow too. Oh, and while I’m browsing these bedroom sets, I need a wall mounted 24 inch option for the dining room that costs no more than $80.
